originalTitle: The smart way to invest in gold right now as the dollar slips
summary: Also in Weekend Reads: Kevin O’Leary’s investing strategy, a 9% dividend paired with lower stock-market risk and advice from the Moneyist.
content:
Also in Weekend Reads: Kevin O’Leary’s investing strategy, a 9% dividend paired with lower stock-market risk and advice from the Moneyist

With the yen sliding early this week after Japan’s central bank kept its policy for the country’s overnight borrowing interest rate at 1%, it wasn’t a surprise to see that Japan’s government started buying yen to prop up the currency’s value. But you might have been surprised when the U.S. Treasury and the Federal Reserve participated in that intervention .

And it was the mechanics of the U.S. move that raised questions about the dollar’s status as the international reserve currency, as Joseph Adinolfi explained.
chineseTitle: 随着美元贬值，现在投资黄金的明智之举
chineseSummary: 周末读物还包括：凯文·奥利里 (Kevin O’Leary) 的投资策略、9% 的股息、较低的股市风险以及货币主义者的建议。
chineseContent:
周末读物还包括：凯文·奥利里 (Kevin O’Leary) 的投资策略，9% 的股息搭配较低的股市风险以及货币主义者的建议

日本央行将隔夜借款利率政策维持在 1% 后，本周初日元汇率下跌，日本政府开始购买日元以支撑日元币值也就不足为奇了。但当美国财政部和美联储参与此次干预时，你可能会感到惊讶。

正如约瑟夫·阿迪诺尔菲（Joseph Adinolfi）解释的那样，正是美国此举的机制引发了人们对美元作为国际储备货币地位的质疑。
